description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (amendment) statute No. 07 of 2017 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of an appropriation statute (Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 10 of 2017) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It involves the modification of financial limits and accounts within an existing legal framework. This falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes, which include "new laws, acts, ordinances, and regulations" and "legal amendments, repeals, or modifications." The content is focused on the legal and regulatory aspects of provincial financial administration, not on government personnel, organisational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
